project.name: Garage
project.architecture_pattern: MVVM with Repository Pattern, Clean Data Layer, and Hilt DI

tech_stack.network: Retrofit / OkHttp 5 (FOSS-only APIs: NHTSA VIN & Recalls, LubeLogger REST API). NetworkModule provides one @Singleton OkHttpClient; LubeLoggerApiFactory and WebDavBackupRepository derive from it via newBuilder().
tech_stack.min_sdk: 33 (Android 13). Guard API 34+ calls with SDK_INT checks (e.g. service/TileLaunch.kt).
tech_stack.view_theming: No appcompat / Material Components. Theme.Garage extends android:Theme.Material.*; the only View-based screen is ui/vehicle/scan/CustomScannerActivity (ComponentActivity + zxing DecoratedBarcodeView, <merge> layout, Theme.Garage.Scanner with black window background).
tech_stack.lint: app/lint.xml suppresses only verified false positives (brand emblem VectorPath, app-name Typos, PluralsCandidate on total-count strings, AGP/Gradle version nags). Lint is expected to be clean (0 errors, 0 warnings).

compliance_constraints: STRICT 100% FOSS Policy - Zero proprietary SDKs (No Google Play Services, Firebase, ML Kit, AdMob, Billing)
Reproducible build compatibility for F-Droid distribution

data_flow_pattern.description: Unidirectional Data Flow (UDF) via MVVM and Repository Pattern

layers.ui: Jetpack Compose screens/components in app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/garage/ui/* observe StateFlow emitted by Hilt ViewModels.
layers.viewmodel: Hilt ViewModels in ui/* handle user events, request data from Repositories, and expose state via StateFlow/SharedFlow.
layers.repository: Repositories in data/repository/* encapsulate data operations, combining Room DAOs, PreferencesManager, and Remote APIs.
layers.local_data: Room DAOs in data/local/dao/* and Entities in data/local/entity/* backed by GarageDatabase in data/local/GarageDatabase.kt.
layers.remote_data: Retrofit APIs in data/remote/* (VinDecoderApi, RecallApi, LubeLoggerApiService).
layers.background: WorkManager Workers in notification/* and notification/lubelogger/* for scheduled reminders, backups, and syncs.

backup_and_network_policy.data_extraction_rules: app/src/main/res/xml/data_extraction_rules.xml (allowBackup=false; Google cloud backup excludes everything; device transfer excludes the EncryptedSharedPreferences files listed in SecurePreferences.kt)
backup_and_network_policy.network_security_config: app/src/main/res/xml/network_security_config.xml (cleartext allowed by default for self-hosted LubeLogger/WebDAV; NHTSA hosts pinned to HTTPS)

localization.locales: values (en), values-de, -fr, -es, -it, -pt, -nl, -pl, -ru, -tr. Every user-visible string must exist in all 10; check parity of <string>/<plurals> names across values*/strings*.xml.
localization.string_files: strings.xml (original) plus per-area files: strings_common, strings_documents, strings_settings, strings_fuel, strings_mods, strings_misc, strings_maintenance, strings_more (suggestions/cost/trips), strings_screens (knowledge/dashboard/recalls/widgets), strings_export. Add new keys to the matching area file in every locale.
localization.enum_labels: app/src/main/java/com/fearmikey/garage/ui/util/EnumLabels.kt: labelRes/label() for VehicleType, Drivetrain, MaintenanceCategory, ModificationCategory, ChargerSpeed, ChargerVendorType, TimelineDateRange, TimeFilter, AppThemePalette, TripCategory. Enum displayName stays stable English (search/CSV/tests); UI must use label().
localization.rules: Tone per locale: de formal 'Sie', fr 'vous', ru 'вы', tr 'siz'; es/it/pt/nl/pl informal. Keep segmented-button labels short (~9 chars; e.g. ru 'Цена/%1$s'). Dates: always use toDisplayDate() (locale-aware FormatStyle.MEDIUM), never hard-coded patterns. Composables: stringResource/pluralStringResource; capture strings in vals before non-composable lambdas. Toasts in composables: LocalResources.current.getString (lint flags LocalContext getString). ViewModels/widgets/non-UI: context.getString. Stored data stays English: fuel type values, maintenance task names, 'Odometer check-in' (LubeLoggerMapper marker), knowledge note 'General' category, schedule template catalog. Not yet translated: the PDF body drawn in MaintenanceExportScreen (fixed-width English canvas layout).

vehicle_management.description: Adding, editing, displaying vehicles, specs, registrations, insurance, notes, and custom documents. Specs (VehicleSpecs) are VIN-decoded and user-editable from the Specs tab (EditSpecsSheet in VehicleSpecsScreen.kt), including user-defined CustomSpec rows stored as JSON in vehicle_specs.customSpecs via Converters.

dashboard.description: App home dashboard displaying fleet summary cards, recent activity, maintenance alerts, and fuel trends.

fuel_and_charging.description: Logging gas fill-ups and EV charging sessions, calculating fuel economy / efficiency, and showing trend graphs.

maintenance_and_schedules.description: Maintenance logging, scheduled maintenance rules/engine, custom rules, suggestions, timeline filtering, and PDF export.

modifications.description: Tracking aftermarket modifications, upgrades, costs, and parts installed per vehicle.

obd2_diagnostics.description: Bluetooth/Wi-Fi OBD-II scanner integration for reading real-time PID data, clearing DTC diagnostic trouble codes.

recalls.description: Fetching safety recall campaign data via NHTSA Recalls API (year/make/model, not VIN). NHTSA answers no-match queries with HTTP 400 + an empty results body; RecallRepository maps that to an empty Success.

cost_of_ownership.description: Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) analytics breaking down fuel, maintenance, mods, insurance, and per-distance metrics.

knowledge_base.description: Vehicle knowledge storage including torque specs, custom documents, fluid capacities, and reference guides.

trip_logging.description: Manual and GPS service-assisted trip logging for mileage categorization (business vs. personal). TripTrackingService filters GPS drift (GPS-only, accuracy/anchor-distance/speed gating) and on Stop & Save inserts the TripRecord itself, exposing it via TripTrackingService.lastSavedTrip so TripLoggerScreen opens it in the edit dialog.

lubelogger_integration.description: Two-way REST API sync with self-hosted LubeLogger instance (vehicles, fuel, service, repairs, upgrades).

backup_and_cloud_sync.description: Local JSON/Database backup/restore, auto-backups, WebDAV remote cloud syncing, and image attachment storage.

settings_and_preferences.description: User preference persistence (units, currency, theme, reminders, developer options).

widgets_and_tiles.description: Android Glance home screen widgets and Quick Settings status bar tiles.

package_index.data/fuel: Calculators and helper classes for gas economy and EV charging stats.
package_index.data/local: Room Database class, converters, and preference managers. SecurePreferences opens EncryptedSharedPreferences files (LubeLogger credentials, WebDAV password) and resets them if their Keystore key is gone.
package_index.data/remote: Retrofit API interfaces (NHTSA VIN Decoder, NHTSA Recalls).
package_index.data/remote/lubelogger: LubeLogger REST API client, DTOs, mappers, and sync engine.
package_index.data/repository: Data repositories bridging DAOs, remote APIs, and UI ViewModels.
package_index.data/schedule: Maintenance schedule engine, rule evaluations, and default templates.
package_index.di: Hilt Dependency Injection modules (DatabaseModule, NetworkModule, RepositoryModule, CoroutineScopeModule providing the @ApplicationScope CoroutineScope).
package_index.notification: WorkManager workers and notification dispatchers for reminders and auto-backups.
package_index.obd: OBD-II Bluetooth & Wi-Fi communication, PID definitions, and response parsing.
package_index.service: Foreground services (TripTrackingService) and Quick Settings TileServices.
package_index.ui/components: Reusable UI components (VehicleCard, TrendChart, Scrollbar, StatusChip, ScrollToTopOnInsert for keeping tab lists pinned to newly inserted top entries, etc.).
package_index.ui/cost: Cost of ownership analytics screen and ViewModel.
package_index.ui/dashboard: Main fleet dashboard screen and components.
package_index.ui/fuel: Fuel & charging logging screen, charts, and ViewModel.
package_index.ui/knowledge: Vehicle knowledge base, documents, torque specs.
package_index.ui/maintenance: Maintenance timeline, suggestion engine screen, and PDF exporter.
package_index.ui/obd: OBD-II scanner screen and device picker dialog.
package_index.ui/recall: Safety recall check screen and ViewModel.
package_index.ui/settings: Settings sub-screens, LubeLogger sync dialogs, and ViewModel.
package_index.ui/theme: Material 3 color schemes, vehicle theme color palettes, and typography.
package_index.ui/util: EnumLabels.kt (localized enum labels, see core_entry_points.localization). AppCurrency.localizedName uses java.util.Currency display names. Unit conversions, date/number formatters, currency definitions. Distances are stored as fractional canonical miles (Double; DB v34 REAL columns) and converted via UnitConverter.canonicalMilesFromInput/displayDistanceValue so km input round-trips exactly; LubeLogger boundary uses toLubeLoggerOdometer/fromLubeLoggerOdometer (whole numbers in the server unit).
package_index.ui/vehicle: Vehicle management, details, registration/insurance, parts estimator.
package_index.widget: Android Glance home screen widgets and receivers.
